context: Start with a v1-to-v2 compatibility inventory covering imports, decorators, annotations, model fields, server metadata, and test introspection. Change the dependency to mcp>=2,<3 and update the lock atomically with the code. Use MCPServer and public SDK listing/call surfaces, supply the BenchBox version explicitly, convert model fields such as readOnlyHint to v2 snake_case equivalents, and keep stdio as the only/default transport in this item. Record any intentional schema delta and require explicit approval rather than silently changing client-visible contracts.
description: Move the existing stdio implementation from Python MCP SDK 1.28.x FastMCP APIs to SDK 2 MCPServer APIs as an intentional major-version migration. Production modules and tests currently import mcp.server.fastmcp.FastMCP, use v1 model-field spellings, omit an explicit BenchBox server version, and in places inspect private SDK manager state. The migration must preserve the current 12-tool, 6-resource, and 7-prompt contract while replacing those v1 assumptions.

anti_patterns.dont: carry a dual v1/v2 abstraction layer indefinitely
anti_patterns.instead: perform one explicit atomic v2 cutover after the temporary v1 cap
anti_patterns.why: it hides incompatible SDK semantics and doubles the test matrix

anti_patterns.dont: reimplement protocol negotiation, discovery, or request-header validation in BenchBox
anti_patterns.instead: use public SDK-v2 server and transport APIs
anti_patterns.why: those are SDK responsibilities and custom copies will drift

anti_patterns.dont: treat private SDK registry-manager attributes as a stable contract
anti_patterns.instead: assert behavior through public list and call APIs
anti_patterns.why: private internals caused avoidable coupling in the v1 tests

preserves.behavior: The registered inventory remains 12 tools, 6 resources, and 7 prompts unless a separately reviewed contract change is documented
Tool inputs, outputs, side effects, result identifiers, and path-containment behavior remain semantically equivalent
stdio remains the default and existing local MCP launch commands continue to work

work_units.summary: Inventory every v1 SDK import, type, model field, decorator, private test hook, and client-visible schema
Move project metadata and uv.lock from the temporary v1 cap to mcp>=2,<3
Replace FastMCP imports and annotations with MCPServer and provide explicit BenchBox server metadata
Port annotations and protocol model fields to SDK-v2 names without changing handler semantics
Replace private SDK-manager assertions with public listing and invocation coverage
Compare pre/post tool, resource, prompt, and JSON-schema inventories and document any approved delta
